serpObservations: Official Yamaha documentation explains DSP as real-time change and mixing of audio signals in a larger digital signal chain; the article avoids claiming a single sound-quality outcome.
Product pages show that DSP feature sets vary by device; readers need a signal-flow and operation checklist rather than a feature count.
cannibalizationNotes: Keep this as the DSP concept pillar. Crossover, limiter and compressor articles should define one function each and link back to this overview.
